customMethods.name: reprintLabel
customMethods.script:
lotId = self.view.params.lotId
	if not lotId:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("No LOT", "No LOT loaded to reprint.", "warning")
		return
	appUserId = self.session.custom.appUserId
	termId = None
	try:
		termId = self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId
	except:
		termId = None
	result = BlueRidge.Lots.LotLabel.reprint(lotId, None, appUserId, termId)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(result, successTitle="LTT reprinted")

customMethods.name: load
customMethods.script:
lotId = self.view.params.lotId
	if not lotId:
		return
	self.view.custom.lot      = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.get(lotId) or self.view.custom.lot
	self.view.custom.history  = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getHistory(lotId)
	self.view.custom.parents  = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getParents(lotId)
	self.view.custom.children = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getChildren(lotId)
	self.view.custom.pauses   = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getPauses(lotId)
	self.view.custom.scrapSummary = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getScrapSummaryOrEmpty(lotId)
	self.view.custom.container = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getLinkedContainerOrEmpty(lotId)
	self.view.custom.samples = BlueRidge.Quality.QualitySample.listByLotInstances(lotId, 0)
	self.view.custom.hold = BlueRidge.Quality.Hold.getOpenByLotOne(lotId)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("holdPanelLoad", payload={"lotId": (self.view.params.lotId or 0), "containerId": 0, "allowLookup": False}, scope="page")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("lotScrapPanelLoad", payload={"lotId": (self.view.params.lotId or 0)}, scope="page")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("lotCountPanelLoad", payload={"lotId": (self.view.params.lotId or 0)}, scope="page")
